problem.title: Tech 01 Db Cutover
problem.decision: Choose a database migration cutover strategy for a stateful service.
context: The service processes customer writes continuously and has a 24x7 usage pattern.
The team has rehearsed logical replication in staging but has not executed a production cutover.
Rollback must remain possible until correctness checks complete.
constraints: Planned write unavailability must stay below 10 minutes.
No committed write may be silently lost.
The migration team has four engineers and no overnight vendor support.
options: A big-bang maintenance cutover with a 30-minute write freeze.
Dual-write from the application for two weeks before switching reads.
Logical replication with a brief write pause, validation, then traffic switch.

evidence.fact: A staging rehearsal of logical replication completed with 42 seconds of replication lag at peak synthetic load.
The application has 19 write paths owned by six modules, and three paths bypass the main repository layer.
A rollback drill from the target database back to the source completed in 7 minutes when the source remained authoritative.
The largest production table is 1.8 TB and a full export/import rehearsal took 96 minutes.
Product has approved one maintenance window capped at 10 minutes of write unavailability.
Change-data-capture monitoring can compare row counts and checksums between source and target during the cutover window.

problem.title: Tech 02 Api Rate Limits

The API runs in three regions behind active-active routing.

constraints: The limiter must prevent one tenant from exhausting shared capacity.
A regional network partition must not stop all requests.
Operational complexity must fit a five-person platform team.

Per-instance in-memory token buckets with no cross-instance coordination.

Platform on-call currently supports eight shared services and has budget for at most one new stateful dependency.

context: A read-heavy endpoint depends on an expensive origin query.
Cache entries for the same key currently expire at the same deterministic TTL.

constraints: Immediate mitigation must reduce origin load today.
The long-term fix must preserve freshness within five minutes.
The team cannot replace the cache product this quarter.

Add jittered expirations plus request coalescing and stale-while-revalidate.
Scale the database and leave cache behavior unchanged.

evidence.fact: During the incident, cache hit rate fell from 94 percent to 37 percent within 40 seconds.
Ninety-one percent of the origin CPU spike came from repeated queries for the same 120 keys.

A database scale-up test reduced query latency by 25 percent but did not prevent saturation under repeated duplicate requests.

problem.title: Tech 05 Queue Ordering
problem.decision: Choose a queue design balancing ordering guarantees, throughput, and retry semantics.
context: A pipeline processes account events and derives billing state.
Ordering is important within an account but unrelated accounts are independent.
Retries occur for transient downstream errors.
constraints: At least 20,000 events per second sustained throughput is required.
Events for the same account must be applied in source order.
A poison event must not block all other accounts.
options: One global FIFO queue with strict ordering.
Partition by account key with ordered processing per partition and dead-letter handling.
Fully unordered workers with application-level last-write-wins reconciliation.

evidence.fact: Load tests of a single FIFO consumer group plateau at 6,500 events per second.
Ninety-nine percent of accounts emit fewer than 10 events per minute, while a small set emits hundreds.
The source assigns a monotonically increasing sequence number per account.
A prior poison event blocked its queue for 38 minutes until manual intervention.
Downstream operations are idempotent when supplied the account id and source sequence number.
The queue platform supports at least 256 partitions and preserves order within a partition key.

evidence.fact: The proposed acquisition channel has a modeled customer acquisition cost 18 percent below the current blended average.
